answered.sql: SELECT SpeciesName FROM Flora_and_fauna WHERE FaunaID IN (SELECT FaunaId FROM Nature_reserves_flora_and_fauna WHERE NatureReserveId IN (SELECT ReserveID FROM Nature_Reserves)) GROUP BY SpeciesName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT NatureReserveId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Nature_Reserves)

candidates.meaning: Find the species of flora and fauna that are present in every nature reserve.
candidates.sql: SELECT SpeciesName FROM Flora_and_fauna WHERE FaunaID IN (SELECT FaunaId FROM Nature_reserves_flora_and_fauna GROUP BY FaunaId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT NatureReserveId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Nature_Reserves))

candidates.meaning: List the species of flora and fauna that are present in all nature reserves.
candidates.sql: SELECT SpeciesName FROM Flora_and_fauna WHERE FaunaID IN (SELECT FaunaId FROM Nature_reserves_flora_and_fauna WHERE NatureReserveId IN (SELECT ReserveID FROM Nature_Reserves) GROUP BY FaunaId HAVING COUNT(NatureReserveId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Nature_Reserves))

candidates.meaning: List the species of flora and fauna that are present in at least one nature reserve.
candidates.sql: SELECT SpeciesName FROM Flora_and_fauna WHERE FaunaID IN (SELECT FaunaId FROM Nature_reserves_flora_and_fauna)

candidates.meaning: List the species of flora and fauna that are present in all nature reserves, considering only those that are fauna.
candidates.sql: SELECT SpeciesName FROM Flora_and_fauna WHERE FaunaID IN (SELECT FaunaId FROM Nature_reserves_flora_and_fauna WHERE NatureReserveId IN (SELECT ReserveID FROM Nature_Reserves) GROUP BY FaunaId HAVING COUNT(NatureReserveId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Nature_Reserves)) AND FaunaID IS NOT NULL
